44.7.0:
# Release Notes for v44.7.0

## Features

* The macOS `autoUpdater` now streams update downloads to disk, resumes an interrupted download on the next check instead of starting over, and applies a binary delta when the update feed offers one for the running version. [#54204](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54204)

## Fixes

* Fixed an uncatchable TypeError in `net.fetch` when receiving response headers with non-ASCII characters, and preserved multiple Set-Cookie headers. [#54672](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54672)

## Other Changes

* Backported fixes from upstream ANGLE, Chromium, Dawn, fontconfig, Skia, V8 and WebRTC. [#54666](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54666)
* Backported fixes from upstream ANGLE, Chromium, Skia, V8 and WebRTC. [#54657](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54657)
44.6.0:
# Release Notes for v44.6.0

## Features

* Added the experimental `protocol.registerSource()` to serve a custom scheme from directories on disk without a JavaScript handler. [#54522](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54522) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54521))</sup>

## Fixes

* Fixed a crash on launch on macOS when the system refused to register the app for sleep/wake notifications. [#54596](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54596)
* Fixed a crash on `navigator.usb.requestDevice()` in in-memory sessions. [#54616](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54616) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54615))</sup>
* Fixed `webview.findInPage()` hanging when the host page also has an iframe. [#54586](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54586) <sup>(Also in [43](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54584), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54585))</sup>
* Updated time zone data to tzdata 2026d, including British Columbia's move to permanent UTC-7. [#54623](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54623)

## Documentation

 * Documentation changes: [#54589](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54589)
